options.content: The dashboard automatically selects a retained LMS trace from the chosen time range. Use **Trace ID** to select another, or click a trace in the search table to open Explore. The waterfall shows browser, Traefik, LMS and database operations. Selected-trace logs search the 7-day trace-retention window; recent application logs below follow the dashboard time range independently of trace selection. If the selected time range has no retained traces, choose a recent/wider range. Old trace links may expire according to Tempo retention; this is not a collector failure.

panels.title: Distributed waterfall · $trace_id
panels.description: Main performance waterfall: expand browser.page → browser.api → Traefik → LMS → database/rendering spans. A health-check trace legitimately has only one span; select a full browser/page trace to inspect page loading.

panels.title: Correlated Loki logs · selected trace (7-day lookup)
panels.description: Searches the last 7 days, matching Tempo retention, independently of a narrow dashboard range. Tempo tag discovery is block-granular and may offer an older retained trace. Recent application logs below still follow the dashboard range.

panels.title: Recent LMS application logs · all requests
panels.description: Independent of trace selection. Ensures current collection can be checked even when an old selected trace has expired.
